meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后,Emacs 会多一个本地 HTTP 桥接:出现聊天缓冲区和 org 模式集成。你能在 Emacs 里直接和 NanoClaw 对话,回复以聊天文本或 org 子标题形式出现。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 中按下聊天快捷键(如 C-c n c)打开缓冲区并发送消息,或对 org 标题/区域执行发送命令时。

say.text: 帮我看看这段代码会不会报错。
say.note: 会在聊天缓冲区得到回答。

say.text: 选中这段,替我做个代码审查。
say.note: 回复会作为子标题插回 org 文件。

say.text: 把这条议程整理成行动项列表。

howto.what_en: Adds a local HTTP bridge that gives Emacs a chat buffer and org-mode integration. You can talk to NanoClaw inside Emacs; answers appear in the buffer or as child headings in org files.
howto.when_en: Fires when you open the Emacs chat buffer with a keybinding (e.g. C-c n c) and send a message, or when you run the org send command on a heading/region.

say_en.text: Help me see if this code could error.
say_en.note: You get an answer in the chat buffer.

say_en.text: Review this selected region for me.
say_en.note: The reply lands as a child heading.

say_en.text: Turn this agenda entry into action items.
say_en.note: The result comes back as a child node.
